name: Tikisuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Rauisuchidae (a grade of 'rauisuchians'); the atlas keeps that parent.
sum: Tikisuchus is a rauisuchid from the Late Triassic Tiki Formation of India, the first rauisuchid described from there.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Tiki Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Chatterjee and Majumdar 1987

sources.text: Chatterjee, S. 1987. ''Tikisuchus romeri'', a new rauisuchid reptile from the Late Triassic of India. Journal of Paleontology 61(4): 787–793. doi:10.1017/S0022336000029139
